instruction: Navigate to the Add-ons Manager in Thunderbird to view installed extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to open the Add-ons Manager tab in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks for the presence of a tab containing 'Add-ons' in its name using the accessibility tree. Similar difficulty to the original - single navigation to access a specific Thunderbird management interface.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks for presence of Add-ons Manager tab in Thunderbird
CSS selector is semantically correct: targets Thunderbird application > tab list > tab with 'Add-ons' in name attribute
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (navigate to Add-ons Manager) and evaluator checks exactly that
Logical correctness: check_accessibility_tree function correctly parses XML accessibility tree, applies CSS selector, and returns 1.0 if tab is found
Getter can extract accessibility tree state, metric can parse and search it correctly
Expected selector using name*='Add-ons' appropriately matches tabs like 'Add-ons Manager', 'Add-ons', etc.
